title: System/370 opcode and behavior repository
summary: Search opcode records using stable aliases such as opcode:5D, mnemonic:D, or name:divide. Records distinguish IBM documentation, executable-reference evidence, and emulator qualification evidence.
rules: Do not infer a mnemonic from neighboring opcode values.
Do not treat an unassigned opcode as an emulator instruction implementation; classify architectural exceptions instead.
Architecture generation matters: later ESA/z reuse does not redefine System/370.
A historical guest repair is accepted only after same-state rewind/retry plus plausible forward progress.
Keep architectural assignment/classification separate from project implementation status and checkpoint sealing status.
For unassigned primary opcodes, prefer a generic architecture-specific exception classifier; do not manufacture OPxx methods merely to make a guest diagnostic progress.
